title: Agreement outside a memory region
statement: For natural numbers $b,K$ and Boolean-valued functions $M,M':\mathbb{Z}\to\{\mathrm{true},\mathrm{false}\}$, define $M'$ to agree with $M$ outside the $K$ positions with addresses $b+v$ for $0\le v<K$ if their values agree at every integer $z$ that is not one of those addresses.
